purpose: Identify mechanisms of shortening rather than tune a scalar length gain.
fixed: same source snapshot and data split fingerprints
same optimizer, epochs, batch, augmentation and checkpoint selection
test remains untouched until validation selection is frozen

interventions.role: tests whether vector loss and conditional directional ambiguity drive radial shrinkage
tests whether averaging the target over the window is a primary driver
validation-only scalar calibration control; no test fitting

decision_rules: A loss mechanism is supported only if magnitude error improves without a paired ATE or 10-second RTE degradation.
A target-averaging mechanism is supported only if velocity_at_end changes the shortening while architecture and loss are held fixed.
A scalar gain is a control and cannot be called a causal explanation or a publishable method.
All three seeds, all failures and subject-group paired intervals must be reported.
